title: Discover Japan with Mount Fuji and Kyoto
alt: Mount Fuji behind a pagoda in spring, Japan
transport: Bullet train, private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Hakone
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Shinjuku, minutes from the station

activities.name: Tokyo city tour with lunch
activities.description: A full day by coach from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and Asakusa, with lunch included.

activities.name: Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip
activities.match: Mount Fuji and Hakone 1 Day Tour
activities.description: Up to the fifth station on Mount Fuji, then Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway, with the bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Three nights in Shinjuku, with a full city day and a trip out to Mount Fuji and Hakone that returns by bullet train.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Kyoto and Nara
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel one stop from Namba, in central Osaka

activities.name: Kyoto and Nara day trip
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, then the deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara, with a buffet lunch and coach travel from Namba.

activities.name: Osaka walking tour
activities.description: Half a day on foot through Dotonbori, the Kuromon market and the lanes around Shinsekai with a guide who knows where to eat.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Four nights in Osaka with a day out to Kyoto and Nara, a walking tour of the food streets and a free day to use as you like.

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Shinjuku hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Tokyo Metropolitan Building viewing decks, free of charge
2: Breakfast, then a full day coach tour of the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Breakfast, then out of the city towards Mount Fuji
The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting
Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway
Bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening
4: Breakfast and check out, then transfer to the station
Check in at your hotel near Namba
Rest of the day free in the city
5: Breakfast, then a full day out to Kyoto and Nara
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara
6: Breakfast, then a half day walking tour of Osaka
Dotonbori and the Kuromon market stalls
The lanes around Shinsekai with your guide
7: Breakfast and a free day in Osaka
Optional: Universal Studios Japan for the day
Optional: Osaka castle and its park
Optional: a day trip to Himeji or Kobe by train
8: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Two bases, one bullet train and no packing every second night. It is the easiest way to see Japan for the first time.
expert.tip: Keep the free day in Osaka for Universal Studios or Himeji castle. Both are easy by train and neither needs a guide.

summary: Eight days between two cities: three nights in Shinjuku with a full Tokyo day and a trip to Mount Fuji and Hakone, then the bullet train to Osaka for four nights with Kyoto, Nara, a walking tour of the food streets and a free day.
included: Included: 7 nights with daily breakfast; bullet train from Tokyo to Osaka; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour with lunch; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip with bullet train return; Kyoto and Nara day trip with buffet lunch; Osaka half day walking tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
